summary: Defines a YANG data model for configuring and managing the Network Time Protocol, version 4, and it can also manage version 3. The model covers both configuration data and operational state data, so management tools can set up and monitor time synchronization consistently. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Computers need to agree on what time it is. This is a standard settings form that lets one control program set up and check the clocks on many machines.
